description: This file contains implementations related to the fsck (file system check) functionality for reftable structures, including validation of table names, checking individual tables, and overall consistency checks within a reftable stack.

methods.name: bool table_has_valid_name(const char * name)
methods.description: Validates that a reftable name string conforms to expected pattern with hexadecimal parts separated by dashes and ending with .ref or .log.

methods.name: int table_check_name(struct reftable_table * table,reftable_fsck_report_fn report_fn,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Checks if a reftable's name is valid, reports an error if invalid.

methods.name: int table_checks(struct reftable_table * table,reftable_fsck_report_fn report_fn,reftable_fsck_verbose_fn verbose_fn UNUSED,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Runs a series of validity checks on a reftable, currently only name check.

methods.name: int reftable_fsck_check(struct reftable_stack * stack,reftable_fsck_report_fn report_fn,reftable_fsck_verbose_fn verbose_fn,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Performs filesystem check by verifying each table in the stack, reporting progress via verbose callback, and accumulating any errors.

ctags.name: table_checks
ctags.signature: (struct reftable_table * table,reftable_fsck_report_fn report_fn,reftable_fsck_verbose_fn verbose_fn UNUSED,void * cb_data)
